prompt:
Rewrite snippets/review-rating-summary.liquid so it renders a review summary computed with integer arithmetic only. The current file is incomplete and produces wrong averages. Inputs (both top-level variables, nothing under section.settings): - ratings: array of integers, or null. Only values from 1 to 5 inclusive are valid. Ignore every other value, such as 0, 6 or 9. A null or empty array means there are no ratings. - heading: string or null. Rules (all counts and sums use valid ratings only): - count = number of valid ratings, sum = their total, positive = number of valid ratings equal to 4 or 5. - If count is 0, output exactly:

No reviews yet

(the heading is never shown in this case). - Otherwise compute, rounding half up and always from the exact values (never from another rounded value): * average to one decimal place = sum/count rounded half up to the nearest tenth. Display it as ., always with exactly one decimal digit (e.g. 5.0, 1.8). * stars = sum/count rounded half up to the nearest integer. * percent = 100*positive/count rounded half up to the nearest integer. - Output, on one line with no whitespace between tags:
[HEADING]AVGCOUNT reviewsPERCENT% recommend
* Use the word "review" when count is 1 and "reviews" otherwise, with one space between the number and the word. * [HEADING]: strip leading and trailing whitespace from heading. If the result is non-empty, output

TEXT

with TEXT HTML-escaped. If heading is null or blank, output nothing in that position. - Produce no other output or whitespace. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/review-rating-summary.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
